title: Odoo's audit trail is in the free edition and on by default since version 19
content:
The Odoo 19 release notes state: *"The non-restrictive audit trail has been made available by default for everyone."* The code sits in `addons/account` inside `odoo/odoo`, whose manifest declares `'license': 'LGPL-3'`, and a repository-scoped code search for `audit_trail` returns files only in the LGPL repository. There is no separate audit module among the Community addons.

The report tracks, per the documentation, *"the date and time of the changes, the user who made the changes, the type of change, the previous value, and the updated value"* — field-level attribution, shipped free.

This refutes the natural hypothesis about Odoo, which is that its open-core split puts audit behind the Enterprise paywall and thereby creates a sovereignty wedge. Audit falls entirely on the LGPL side, so that wedge does not exist.
description: The Audit Trail lives in addons/account under LGPL-3 and the non-restrictive mode was made available by default for everyone, so no open-core paywall exists on audit.
